Container.Name: WhatsAppSeerrBridge
Container.Overview: Bridge WhatsApp to Seerr (Overseerr/Jellyseerr) for media requests. Users request movies/shows directly from a WhatsApp chat. If you see 'Navigating frame was detached' in the logs, add --shm-size=1gb to Extra Parameters (Advanced) - Chromium renderer crashes with Docker's default 64MB /dev/shm.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal HTTP port (matches Web UI Port)
